tool: Built-in imagegen for pose studies; normalized and drawn on the native grid for delivery.

heroes.office-worker: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel art animation key poses for Midlife Survivors, using the attached approved hero sprite sheet as identity reference. messy gray-templed brown hair, black rectangular glasses, cream short-sleeve shirt, loose red tie, khakis and orange mug. One SAME character in an EXACT 4-column by 2-row evenly spaced grid, full body, three-quarter front view throughout, same floor line and size, plenty of space around each figure. Top row: relaxed neutral; lift orange coffee to mouth; lower and exhale; push glasses with the free hand (one pose each in columns 2,3,4). Bottom row: neutral hands on hips; back stretch anticipation; peak lower-back stretch with shoulders and face gently tilted back, hands on hips; relaxing to neutral. Target design about 85px tall on a native 96x112 pixel art grid; crisp warm cream top-left highlights, one logical pixel dark navy edge, simple color clusters, retain sprite palette and character's clothing exactly. Transparent background, no ground shadows, no text, no captions or dividers. No floating symbols, keep each pose independent.
